The following events took place in '''15 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Tahiri Veila]] was orphaned.
*[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] confronted [[Brakiss]] for his [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] leanings, and the latter fled [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="NEC" />
*[[Ailyn Vel]] concluded that her [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], was dead.
*The [[Aradian pulse-lifter]] was developed. {{Circa}}
*[[Sliven]] was injured badly during a battle between his tribe of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] and a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].
*Skywalker achieves the ability to [[Force cloak|cloak]] objects with [[The Force/Legends|The Force]].<ref name="Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
*The [[Nebula-class Star Destroyer|''Nebula''-class Star Destroyer]], the last of eight new [[Starship/Legends|starship]] designs in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[New Class Modernization Program]], is introduced.<ref name="NEC" />

==Births==
